introduction_text:
This is a data collection tool that helps track and monitor implementation of AA within the country. Partners and government agencies are encouraged to share anticipatory action intervention data in order to consolidate information on Anticipatory Action (AA) efforts, enhance coordination and avoid duplication of AA interventions in a particular locality. This information is collected per intervention and at sub county level for each implementing entity.

For any questions or clarification reach out to:

hindada.boneya@icha.net

info@ndoc.go.ke
